trainer/32197.htm.text: Master Gwain: After the establishment of this Kamael Guild, we were forced to struggle to survive. A lesser breed would have been defeated, but we faced our troubles and overcame them in the true Kamael fashion. How could we not? A Kamael without honor is truly a pitiful sight.

trainer/32197-noteach.htm.text: Master Dwain: You wish to learn new skills from me? Hmph! That simply isn't possible, I'm afraid. I don't know who misinformed you, but I only teach male Kamael Soldiers and Troopers. GO find another master!

Q00062_PathOfTheTrooper/32197-01.htm.text: Master Gwain: So you have come here because you want to become a Dragoon, eh? You should know that we only admit those who possess the right temperament and natural ability to learn our sophisticated skills. In short, you must pass a test to prove yourself to us. Interested?
when: state CREATED; level >= 18; player.getRace() == Race.KAMAEL; player.getClassId() == ClassId.maleSoldier

Q00062_PathOfTheTrooper/32197-02.html.text: Master Gwain: Ah, you have undoubtedly come here in order to become a Trooper. It is true that as a Trooper, you will be able to learn more and higher-level skills. But our guild only recognizes those whom we judge to be qualified and capable for this honor. Put simply, to become a Trooper you must…
when: state CREATED; NOT level >= 18; player.getRace() == Race.KAMAEL; player.getClassId() == ClassId.maleSoldier

Q00062_PathOfTheTrooper/32197-03.html.text: Master Gwain: Ah, so you wish to become a Trooper? I am sorry, but this is not your path. You cannot become a Trooper. Find the destiny right for you. (Only male Kamael Soldiers who are level 18 and above may undertake this quest.)

Q00062_PathOfTheTrooper/32197-04.html.text: Master Gwain: You want to become a Dragoon, eh? I'm sorry, but your race is not eligible. (Only Kamael characters may embark on this quest.)

Q00062_PathOfTheTrooper/32197-07.html.text: Master Gwain: First, go to Master Shubain in Gludin Village, train under him and obtain his recommendation. Then return here and we will discuss the test in more detail.

Q00062_PathOfTheTrooper/32197-08.html.text: Master Gwain: You have a letter of recommendation from Master Shubain? Good work! You no longer have the look of a novice... Now I think you are ready for the test. Follow the road that runs west of this village to a place called the Ruins of Agony . Defeat the Tumran Bugbear and bring me his heart…

Q00062_PathOfTheTrooper/32197-09.html.text: Master Gwain: Go to the Ruins of Agony that lie to the west of this village, defeat the Tumran Bugbear and bring me his heart.

Q00062_PathOfTheTrooper/32197-10.html.text: Master Gwain: Ah, the heart of the Tumran Bugbear. Well done! You will make an excellent Dragoon. Take this letter of recommendation to Grand Master Gershwin of the Kamael Guild and he will approve your class transfer. Congratulations!

Q00062_PathOfTheTrooper/32197-05.html.text: Master Gwain: You have already passed the test! Didn't you go through with your class transfer? If not, go to Grand Master Gershwin of the Kamael Guild. He will help you. (You have already completed this quest.)

Q00062_PathOfTheTrooper/32197-06.htm.text: Master Gwain: Excellent! I like your boldness. The test itself is very simple. You must defeat a certain malignant spirit to prove your bravery and strength and bring back the creature's heart as proof. But no matter how talented you may be, a lack of experience will make you easy prey for this spi…

links.text: Ask about the Agathion in charge of skill enchantment.

common/skill_enchant_help_01.htm.text: Skill Enchanting allows you to strengthen certain skills that have reached their maximum level. You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!

common/skill_enchant_help_03.htm.text: There are several Skill Enchanting options at your disposal: General Skill Enchant, Blessed Skill Enchant, Skill Un-Enchanting and Skill Route Change.
